input._script:
using JSON3
sh(c) = try replace(strip(read(`bash -c $c`, String)), "\n" => " | ") catch e; "ERR" end

r = Dict{String,Any}()
op = get(ENV, "OPAL_PREFIX", "")
r["OPAL_PREFIX"]      = op
r["opal_mpirun"]      = sh("ls -l $op/bin/mpirun 2>&1")
r["opal_mpirun_ver"]  = sh("$op/bin/mpirun --version 2>&1 | head -1")
r["softs_vs_logic"]   = sh("readlink -f /softs/nvidia; readlink -f /home/logiciels/nvidia")
r["softs_hpcx_mpirun"]= sh("ls -l /softs/nvidia/hpc_sdk/Linux_x86_64/24.1/comm_libs/hpcx/bin/mpirun 2>&1")

try
    import MPIPreferences
    r["mpipref_binary"] = string(MPIPreferences.binary)
    r["mpipref_abi"]    = string(MPIPreferences.abi)
catch e
    r["mpipref_binary"] = "ERR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
end
try
    import MPI
    r["mpi_libmpi"]  = string(MPI.libmpi)
    r["mpi_version"] = replace(string(MPI.MPI_LIBRARY_VERSION_STRING), "\n" => " | ")
    r["mpi_impl"]    = string(MPI.MPI_LIBRARY)
catch e
    r["mpi_import"] = "ERR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("diag" => r)))
